objective: Find organizations with publicly documented fixed-arm rigid-object pick-and-place workcells and an existing robot-policy testing process.

match_conditions.name: fixed_arm_workcell
match_conditions.description: Public sources describe a fixed robot arm performing rigid-object pick-and-place in a workcell. Retain source citations; inferred suitability requires human review.

match_conditions.name: policy_testing_process
match_conditions.description: Public sources describe an existing process for evaluating runnable robot policies or configurations on physical hardware. Missing evidence does not establish eligibility.
